title: Children at Outdoor Baby Birthday Party, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: [Circular stamp]: ...WELL CO. PHOTO SERVICE / SEP 5 193... [Watermark]: VELOX
description: A candid outdoor snapshot from the 1930s capturing an informal family gathering around a table set for a baby's birthday party. The baby sits in a high chair next to a decorated birthday cake and wrapped presents resting on a patterned tablecloth. Five older siblings or neighborhood children gather around, dressed in Depression-era summer casuals and early swimwear, set against a backdrop of trees and shaded yard.
